meta.title: Irumudi
description: Troubled by a history of violence and an addiction to alcohol, a man strives to leave his turbulent background behind. He now lives peacefully alongside his daughter in a serene environment right beside a waterfall, focusing on maintaining a quiet, harmonious life together away from the chaos of his former years.

His path takes a transformative turn when he decides to fulfill a special request made by his daughter. Moving to answer her wish, he resolves to undertake the sacred Ayyappa Deeksha, embarking on a demanding 41-day spiritual vow that requires adhering to a strict period of intense austerity.
